Catalog membership is cached with transactional revision invalidation; ratings and heat are always current. 目录成员和分面来自同一持久投影版本，实时评分与热度按 ID 关联。游标绑定投影版本，目录重建或热门等含热度排序的窗口换日后，旧游标返回 409，应从第一页重新读取。 普通目录仅提供学校、院系、分类、性质、学期、课程和教师；term_course、class、assignment、schedule 仅供管理端或受信服务使用。

Expired/invisible courses are excluded immediately. Resource counts are live, batched and current-visible; a disabled resource provider is explicitly unavailable.

delete.description: Idempotently clear only the authenticated owner. Current school eligibility is not required to erase personal history.

put.description: Record a current-readable course using server time. Per-owner serialization preserves the newest 20 unique canonical courses and removes expired records. Repeated visits replace the timestamp; request payloads cannot set an owner or time.

post.description: Requires catalog.teacher-sites.refresh and current school management scope. Audited durable enqueue. Only one queued/running refresh globally; a competing request returns 409. Replay with the same actor, school, key and mode returns the original run; a different mode conflicts. Use the returned deadline_at as the expiry of the specific run, including queue time. The monthly scheduler only enqueues incremental work. A timeout preserves the published snapshot.
